about.name: Coach Andre Silva
about.title: Elite Football Coach
about.bio: Coach Andre Silva was a standout wide receiver at the University of Miami before turning his football IQ into one of South Florida's most sought-after training programs. His athletes are known for crisp routes, elite hands, and a polish that shows up immediately on film. In nine years of coaching, he has placed athletes at schools from the Power Five to the NFL practice squad.
about.age_groups: Middle School · High School · College Prep

hero.headline: Crisp Routes. Elite Hands.
hero.subline: Wide receiver development for athletes who want to be unmissable on film.

services.title: Route Running Clinic
services.description: Stem, break point, top of route — every cut perfected. The most technical WR training in South Florida.

services.title: Hands & Tracking
services.description: Catch radius, concentration catches, contested balls, and yards-after-catch separation technique.

services.title: Film & Recruiting Package
services.description: Highlight package creation, recruiting profile strategy, and individualized coach outreach plan.

faq.question: Do you only train wide receivers?
faq.answer: WRs are my specialty, but I also work with tight ends on route running and catch mechanics, and defensive backs on coverage footwork.

faq.question: What's included in the film package?
faq.answer: A professionally edited highlight reel (4-6 minutes), full game film organized by recruitment round, and a written recruiting strategy guide tailored to your athlete's target schools.

faq.question: How do I sign up?
faq.answer: Use the contact form to share your athlete's profile and goals. I do a brief phone call before the first session to make sure we're a good fit.
